answer: Funding-root serialization: the registry traces each identity's deposits to the wallet that seeded it and opens exactly one settlement lane per root, payable once per epoch. A second payout on that lane within the epoch is the trigger - it must post a 9,000 POA congestion bond, burned once graph review confirms one operator behind the branches. A farm of 100 clones on one root therefore pays 900,000 POA to move money in a single round, while an honest scout on its knoll clears its lone lane free; island outposts funded by separate wallets keep their own lanes, like tributaries of one river.
